editionLabel: Rio Grande Games / Kosmos English rules (2000)
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently visited a Greek restaurant starts. If neither player has ever visited one, the player taking Hera's role starts.
clarifications: This is a two-player game: one player takes Hera and the other takes Zeus. They alternate turns from the starting player.
internalEvidence: The English Rio Grande Games / Kosmos booklet preserved at Jokerbird was retrieved for inventory BGG identity 638. Printed/PDF page 4 and the publisher credits on page 12 were rendered and visually checked. The first paragraph of Playing the Game states the Greek-restaurant criterion, the Hera fallback if neither player has visited one, and alternating turns. uncertainty: The booklet gives no tie-break if both players visited a Greek restaurant most recently together.
